edges.reason: msg.sender becomes the initial owner in the Owned constructor.
Owned constructor assigns owner = msg.sender.
onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender to owner before transferOwnership executes.
transferOwnership writes the caller supplied _newOwner into newOwner.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner.
acceptOwnership overwrites owner with newOwner.
acceptOwnership resets newOwner to address(0).
SpenceBuck constructor sets symbol to SBK.
SpenceBuck constructor sets name to SpenceBuck.
SpenceBuck constructor sets decimals to 18.
SpenceBuck constructor sets _totalSupply.
SpenceBuck constructor pre-mints the whole supply to the deployer address in balances.
totalSupply computes an unchecked subtraction.
Unchecked subtraction reads _totalSupply.
Unchecked subtraction reads balances[address(0)], which can make the result underflow.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
transfer uses msg.sender as the debited sender.
approve uses msg.sender as the allowance owner.
transferFrom uses msg.sender as the allowance spender.
approveAndCall uses msg.sender as the allowance owner and forwards it.
transferAnyERC20Token is gated by the onlyOwner check on msg.sender.
transfer calls safeSub on the sender balance.
transfer calls safeAdd on the recipient balance.
transfer updates the balances mapping.
approve writes the allowed mapping.
transferFrom calls safeSub on balances and on the allowance.
transferFrom calls safeAdd on the recipient balance.
transferFrom updates the balances mapping.
transferFrom decrements the allowed mapping.
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
approveAndCall writes the allowed mapping before the external call.
approveAndCall performs an external call into the caller supplied spender contract.
receiveApproval can re-enter transfer during the external call.
receiveApproval can re-enter transferFrom during the external call.
transferAnyERC20Token performs an external call to an arbitrary token contract.
transferAnyERC20Token sends the recovered tokens to the owner address.

second operand b of safeAdd.

normalization_plan.reason: tokens is a plain value parameter of transfer and adds no distinct security semantics.
to is a plain address parameter of transfer and can be folded into the function node.
from is a plain address parameter of transferFrom and carries no independent state.
spender is the callee of the external call in approveAndCall and should be folded into that function.
tokenOwner is a read-only lookup key used by allowance and balanceOf.
_newOwner is directly written into the newOwner state variable by transferOwnership.
tokenAddress only selects the external contract called by transferAnyERC20Token.
data is opaque calldata only forwarded by approveAndCall.
a is the first operand of the SafeMath arithmetic helpers.
b is the second operand of the SafeMath arithmetic helpers.
c is the temporary result variable inside the SafeMath helpers.
balance is only the return slot of balanceOf.
remaining is only the return slot of allowance.
success is only the boolean return slot of the transfer family of functions.
